in_hebrew.name: Rolph
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Rolph הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old High German name Hrodulf, which means 'fame wolf' or 'renowned wolf'. This name was commonly given to warriors and rulers.

in_greek.name: Rolph
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Wolf Counselor
in_greek.long_meaning: Rolph είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Old High German name Hrodulf, which means 'fame wolf' or 'renowned wolf'. This name was commonly given to warriors and rulers.

in_latin.name: Rolph
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Wolf Counselor
in_latin.long_meaning: Rolph est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Old High German name Hrodulf, which means 'fame wolf' or 'renowned wolf'. This name was commonly given to warriors and rulers.
